frame.note: Fixed frame. Yellow D first; white U last. Clockwise is viewed directly at the turned face.

state.goal: Solve the four yellow edges on D with side colors matching centers. You may use a daisy on U or insert directly.

turn.instructions: Choose one face turn that moves the target toward its requiredStickerDirections and destination while protecting solved pieces. Read the static direction mappings in the options. If one turn solves the entire cube, choose it. Quarter turns are clockwise looking directly at that face; prime is counterclockwise.

criteria.U: Turn U clockwise looking at that face. Only pieces touching U move. Their sticker directions change: F→L, L→B, B→R, R→F; the U sticker direction stays fixed.
criteria.U': Turn U counterclockwise looking at that face. Only pieces touching U move. Their sticker directions change: F→R, L→F, B→L, R→B; the U sticker direction stays fixed.
criteria.U2: Turn U 180 degrees looking at that face. Only pieces touching U move. Their sticker directions change: F→B, L→R, B→F, R→L; the U sticker direction stays fixed.
criteria.D: Turn D clockwise looking at that face. Only pieces touching D move. Their sticker directions change: F→R, R→B, B→L, L→F; the D sticker direction stays fixed.
criteria.D': Turn D counterclockwise looking at that face. Only pieces touching D move. Their sticker directions change: F→L, R→F, B→R, L→B; the D sticker direction stays fixed.
criteria.D2: Turn D 180 degrees looking at that face. Only pieces touching D move. Their sticker directions change: F→B, R→L, B→F, L→R; the D sticker direction stays fixed.
criteria.F: Turn F clockwise looking at that face. Only pieces touching F move. Their sticker directions change: U→R, R→D, D→L, L→U; the F sticker direction stays fixed.
criteria.F': Turn F counterclockwise looking at that face. Only pieces touching F move. Their sticker directions change: U→L, R→U, D→R, L→D; the F sticker direction stays fixed.
criteria.F2: Turn F 180 degrees looking at that face. Only pieces touching F move. Their sticker directions change: U→D, R→L, D→U, L→R; the F sticker direction stays fixed.
criteria.B: Turn B clockwise looking at that face. Only pieces touching B move. Their sticker directions change: U→L, L→D, D→R, R→U; the B sticker direction stays fixed.
criteria.B': Turn B counterclockwise looking at that face. Only pieces touching B move. Their sticker directions change: U→R, L→U, D→L, R→D; the B sticker direction stays fixed.
criteria.B2: Turn B 180 degrees looking at that face. Only pieces touching B move. Their sticker directions change: U→D, L→R, D→U, R→L; the B sticker direction stays fixed.
criteria.R: Turn R clockwise looking at that face. Only pieces touching R move. Their sticker directions change: U→B, B→D, D→F, F→U; the R sticker direction stays fixed.
criteria.R': Turn R counterclockwise looking at that face. Only pieces touching R move. Their sticker directions change: U→F, B→U, D→B, F→D; the R sticker direction stays fixed.
criteria.R2: Turn R 180 degrees looking at that face. Only pieces touching R move. Their sticker directions change: U→D, B→F, D→U, F→B; the R sticker direction stays fixed.
criteria.L: Turn L clockwise looking at that face. Only pieces touching L move. Their sticker directions change: U→F, F→D, D→B, B→U; the L sticker direction stays fixed.
criteria.L': Turn L counterclockwise looking at that face. Only pieces touching L move. Their sticker directions change: U→B, F→U, D→F, B→D; the L sticker direction stays fixed.
criteria.L2: Turn L 180 degrees looking at that face. Only pieces touching L move. Their sticker directions change: U→D, F→B, D→U, B→F; the L sticker direction stays fixed.

goal.instructions: Choose the goal whose prerequisites match the current measurements. Apply the fixed definitions in the options. uncollectedYellowEdges counts yellow edges that are neither yellow-up petals nor solved bottom edges. PreviousGoal is memory, not an instruction; choose using present conditions. Completion flags describe structures, not recommendations. The program stops separately when all pieces are solved.

criteria.daisy: Gather yellow edges as top petals. Choose when cross=false and uncollectedYellowEdges>0. Preserve solved bottom edges and existing petals.
criteria.cross: Transfer yellow-up petals to their bottom homes. Choose when cross=false and uncollectedYellowEdges=0. This controller only transfers petals; it cannot extract or gather missing petals.
criteria.top-cross: Orient white top edges. Choose when middle=true and topCross=false.
criteria.top-orientation: Orient white top corners. Choose when middle=true, topCross=true and topOriented=false.
criteria.pll: Place the oriented top corners and edges together. Choose when completed.middle=true, completed.topCross=true, completed.topOriented=true and completed.solved=false.
criteria.f2l: Solve the four yellow-corner/middle-edge pairs together. Choose when completed.cross=true and completed.middle=false. Preserve the completed cross and already solved pairs.
